name: Kami nomi zo Shiru
source:
A year and a half after being taken in by Rubis, Gio suddenly hears from Rubis that he will die in a week.
"You've got to spend the next week without any regrets."
Perhaps out of worry for Gio, Rubis visits him every day. What's going to happen to Gio after the week is over?

[Translated from [url=http://thunders.silk.to/ts/index.php/page/game/kamino]official website[/url]]
translation:
被鲁比斯收留一年半后，吉奥突然从鲁比斯那里得知自己一周后就会死去。
“你必须度过接下来的一周，不要有任何遗憾。”
也许是出于对吉奥的担心，鲁比斯每天都会去看望他。一周结束后吉奥会发生什么？

[译自[url=http://thunders.silk.to/ts/index.php/page/game/kamino]官方网站[/url]]
